user.title: Configure vehicle and charger
user.description: Create a charging profile. Add more profiles for other vehicles and chargers. The energy sensor must represent energy delivered in the current session.

data_description.vehicle_name: Example: Electric car. Used to identify this device and its entities.
data_description.charging_entity: A binary_sensor where on means charging and off means stopped. unknown/unavailable never mean charging finished.
data_description.energy_entity: Energy delivered during the current session, in kWh or Wh. Do not select power or a cumulative meter in this first version.
data_description.energy_mode: This initial version supports a session energy counter that resets for each new charge.
data_description.odometer_entity: Total vehicle distance. Required for odometer-based finalization.
data_description.odometer_unit: Unit used to normalize the odometer.
data_description.price_mode: Choose a fixed manual price or a Home Assistant sensor.
data_description.price_per_kwh: Used when manual mode is selected. Example: 0.11 €/kWh.
data_description.price_entity: Numeric sensor whose state is the price in €/kWh. The value is snapshotted when charging starts.
data_description.finalization: Odometer: wait until the vehicle moves. Immediate: finalize when charging stops. Manual is not available yet.

error.name_required: Enter a vehicle name and charger name.
error.price_sensor_required: Select a price sensor to use automatic pricing.

abort.already_configured: This vehicle and charger profile is already configured.
abort.options_not_available_yet: Sensor mapping can be edited in a future version.
